title: DCB0129, DCB0160 and NHS AI procurement: what every vendor must demonstrate
subtitle: The DSPT, DTAC, and AI Diagnostic Fund are reshaping how the NHS evaluates and funds AI
excerpt: NHS Digital Security and Trust (DCB0129) and the Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DCB0160) set the governance bar for any AI deployed in NHS England.
content:
The governance bar for NHS AI

NHS Digital Security and Trust (DCB0129) and the Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DCB0160) set the governance bar for any AI deployed in NHS England. Combined with the AI Diagnostic Fund and the Digital Technologies Assessment Checklist (DTAC), these frameworks define what procurement teams must see before adoption.

For a clinical AI vendor, meeting these requirements means demonstrating cyber-resilience, data governance, clinical safety evidence, and a defined procurement pathway. SEWA's documentation pack addresses each checkpoint directly — from security architecture to data governance to clinical safety evidence — so that NHS procurement teams can evaluate SEWA against a standard they already understand.
author: Dolapo Ariyo
